title: Supported MCP Server Decoy Applications and Tools

blocks.text: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server decoy integrates an AI application or a Large Language Model (LLM) chatbot with decoy applications and tools. The AI application or LLM uses these decoy tools to generate fake responses. The following tables show the supported MCP applications and tools:

table: Searches Bitbucket workspaces for repositories by name, description, or metadata. Returns repository information, URLs, owner details, and project associations.
Searches code content within Bitbucket repositories across all or specific workspaces. Returns matching snippets with file paths, line numbers, and highlighted matches.
Searches and retrieves build or pipeline artifacts from Bitbucket Pipelines. Returns artifact metadata including content previews, pipeline information, and download links.
Retrieves keyspace names (strings), which include additional driver-specific metadata (e.g., durable_writes, replication, etc.).
Returns query results as a list of row objects (mapping column names to values), along with optional metadata (columns and paging information).
Returns cluster or server details such as cluster name, release version, data centers, and node/host information.
Returns a list of indices, such as name, health/status, document count, and store size. Some implementations might return only the index names.
Searches log indices. Returns log hits (e.g., timestamp, message, host, service, and level), total hit count, and any aggregations.
Returns cluster details, such as cluster name, status/health, number of nodes, version, and node roles.
Retrieves a list of database names (strings), including owner and size details, if specified.
Returns rows as a list of objects/records with column-value mappings and optional column metadata.
Returns server and version information, such as server version, current database, and settings snapshot with optional connection parameters.
Searches a Confluence page by its title or name. Returns the complete page with body content, labels, and metadata.
Searches Confluence using CQL (Confluence Query Language). Returns matching pages with titles, excerpts, and metadata.
Returns a list of repository objects, such as ID, name, full name, description, topics, visibility, stars, URLs, total count, and pagination information.
Returns code search results with repository reference, file path, score, and text matches/snippets.
Returns a list of commit objects, such as SHA, author/committer, message, date, and parent SHA for the specified repository/branch.
Returns a list of pull request comments with commenter details, body, timestamps, file/path and line references, and review thread information.
Returns a list of repository/project objects, such as ID, name, path, description, visibility, web URL, and pagination information.
Returns code search results with repository/project reference, file path, matched snippet/context, and pagination information.
Returns a list of commit objects, such as ID/SHA, author, message, date, and parent SHA for the specified repository/branch.
Returns a list of comments/notes on a merge request, including author details, body, timestamps, and thread metadata.
Performs a full-text search across Google Drive, including file names, documents, and metadata.
Searches and reads Google Sheets spreadsheets by file name. Returns metadata and cell values.
Searches and reads Google Docs documents by file name. Returns metadata and body content.
Searches Google Chat spaces and direct messages. Returns matching messages with sender's information and thread context.
Searches and retrieves Google Slides presentations by name. Returns presentation metadata, slides, and page elements.
Searches Jenkins build logs for specified patterns (string or regex). Returns matching lines with context, build metadata, and line numbers.
Retrieves the SCM (Source Code Management) configuration of a Jenkins job. Returns repository URLs, credentials references, branch configurations, and polling settings.
Returns a list of issues matching the Jira Query Language (JQL), including fields per issue (key, ID, summary, status, assignee, etc.), total count, and pagination information.
Returns an issue object with full details (key, ID, fields, and transitions/links).
Retrieves information about a specific user with Slack ID or Slack username. Returns a JSON file with user information, including the Slack profile picture.
Searches Slack conversations across different channels for a specified string. Returns matching messages.
Lists all Slack channels by channel type.
Queries standard Salesforce objects (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Case, Contract) using SOQL (Salesforce Object Query Language). Returns matching records.
Lists random analytics reports from the organization's Salesforce report library. Returns report metadata including name, folder, format, and last run date.
Retrieves the full data for a specific Salesforce report by name. Returns report metadata and CSV-exportable data.
Retrieves comprehensive Salesforce account details by company name, including account info, contacts, opportunities, contracts, support cases, and account team members.
